notes: Fix: the DRIVE effect was hard-wired 100% wet — deafeningly loud on drums, and the FX amount slider barely did anything; it's now a true wet/dry blend with compensated level (measured). LUMI COLORS: every SysEx frame is now sent under BOTH device ids (0x37 and broadcast 0x00) — the community protocol doc is uncertain which id a given unit answers to, and if yours wanted the other one, every color/scale frame was being silently ignored. If the keybed still doesn't take colors after this, tap 'Push to LUMI now' in Settings > MIDI and tell me what happens — the next stop would be a firmware-version difference.
